sources.title: Spatio-Temporal Deep Learning-Assisted Reduced Security-Constrained Unit Commitment
sources.citation: Arun Venkatesh Ramesh and Xingpeng Li, Spatio-Temporal Deep Learning-Assisted Reduced Security-Constrained Unit Commitment, Figshare dataset V2, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.24116394.v2; associated IEEE Transactions on Power Systems paper 39(2), 4735-4746 (2024), DOI 10.1109/TPWRS.2023.3313430.

sources.model_scope: Author-published SCUC and machine-learning research data. Paper reports IEEE 24/73/118-bus and synthetic South-Carolina 500-bus systems. Includes prepared data and generated graph samples; graphs are not independent UC systems. Upstream Pyomo CPLEX/Gurobi usage is not this project's solver compatibility certification.
